quests.instruction: Touch the body part that can be an 'innie' or an 'outie' -- but it is not your shoulders!
quests.question: Belly Button
quests.hint: It can be an innie or an outie.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Some belly buttons are innies, and some are outies.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that has a hard bone right under a thin layer of skin -- but it is not your toenails!
quests.question: Shins
quests.hint: They are between your knee and your ankle, in front.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: Shins can feel extra sore because the bone sits close to your skin.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found at the tip of your nose, one on each side -- but it is not your eyelashes!
quests.question: Nostrils
quests.hint: Air goes in and out through these.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: Nostrils help warm and clean the air before it reaches your lungs.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps your hand grip a crayon to draw. It is NOT your armpits!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You point these up to say 'great job!'
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Your thumbs help your hands grip things tightly, like a cup or a pencil!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the back of your leg, between your knee and your ankle. It is also the one that tightens up when you stand on your tiptoes, but it is NOT your legs!
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: Hint: They tighten when you stand on tiptoes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Strong calves help you jump higher and run faster.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where you might wear a cozy bracelet or watch. It is NOT your fingers!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are found where your hand meets your arm!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: Each of your wrists has eight tiny bones that help it bend!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you rest on your hand when you are thinking hard. It is NOT your tongue!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is at the very bottom of your face!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Humans are the only animals with a pointy chin like this!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that smiles big when you feel happy and proud. It is also the one you look at in the mirror every morning, but it is NOT your head!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Think about this: Your eyes, nose, and mouth are all part of it.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Smiling uses fewer muscles in your face than frowning.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that fills up with air when you take a big breath. It is NOT your collarbone!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You can feel your heart beating right here!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: Your chest holds two very important helpers: your heart and your lungs!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that holds your brain safe inside, like a helmet made of bone, not your cheeks!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You shake it side to side to say no.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Your head makes up a big part of your whole body when you are a baby!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that lets your head nod, shake, and turn around, not your collarbone!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Here's a tip: A scarf wraps around this part in winter.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck works hard to hold up your head all day long!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you use to ride a bicycle around the block, not your knees!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use these to kick a ball.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Your two legs work together perfectly every time you ride a bike!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that keeps your head warm on a cold, snowy day, not your nostrils!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It sits right on top, above your forehead.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: You have about one hundred thousand hairs growing on your head!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the round back part of your foot. It is also the one that touches the ground first when you walk, but it is NOT your kneecap!
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: Hint: They touch the ground first when you take a step.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: A cushiony pad inside each heel helps soften every step.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that a grandparent might gently pinch to say hello. It is also the one that pushes up high on your face when you smile, but it is NOT your jaw!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: Think about this: They puff up when you blow out birthday candles.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Babies often have extra round, chubby cheeks.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found just below your neck, running side to side, not your neck!
quests.question: Collarbone
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It connects your shoulder to your chest.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Collarbone is the thin bone below your neck that connects your shoulder to your chest!
quests.funFact: It runs sideways from your shoulder to the top of your chest.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you shrug when you are not sure of the answer. It is also the one that holds up the straps of your backpack, but it is NOT your hips!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Your backpack straps rest right on these!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Your shoulders let your arms swing all the way around!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to point at a pretty rainbow. It is also the one we count on when we learn numbers, but it is NOT your arms!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: You have five on each hand!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: You have ten fingers, and each one has its own fingerprint!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that gives your whole body its shape and lets you stand up, not your lungs!
quests.question: Skeleton
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is underneath your muscles and skin.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Skeleton is the name for all the bones in your body working together!
quests.funFact: Your skeleton also protects the soft, important parts inside you.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to give a warm, big hug. It is also the one we use to wave hello and goodbye, but it is NOT your palms!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: You have two, and you hug people with them!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: You use over thirty muscles just to bend and lift your arms!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets you fold your arm to eat your dinner. It is also the one found halfway between your shoulder and your wrist, but it is NOT your hands!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: Think about this: You bend these to bring food to your mouth.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: That funny, tingly feeling when you bump your elbow has a nickname: the funny bone.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to hear birds singing. It is also the one we use to listen to happy music, but it is NOT your forehead!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: You have two, one on each side of your head!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Your ears never stop listening, even while you sleep!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found wherever two bones meet and move together, not your brain!
quests.question: Joints
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are found wherever two bones meet.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Joints are the bendy parts, like elbows and knees, where two bones meet!
quests.funFact: Stretching and moving every day helps keep your joints healthy.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that keeps your mouth closed when it is not talking. It is also the one you smack together after a tasty, sweet treat, but it is NOT your tongue!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: Think about this: They are the soft edges around your mouth.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Lips do not have the tiny glands that keep the rest of your skin moist.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that protects your knee joint when you kneel down, not your soles!
quests.question: Kneecap
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You can feel it move when you bend your leg.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Kneecap is the small round bone at the front of your knee that protects it!
quests.funFact: You can feel your kneecap glide a little when you bend your leg.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to taste yummy strawberries. It is also the one that helps you taste if food is sweet or sour, but it is NOT your chin!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: It helps you taste sweet, sour, and salty foods!
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds on it!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that a dentist checks along with your teeth, not your eyebrows!
quests.question: Gums
quests.hint: Here's a tip: A dentist checks these along with your teeth.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Gums are the soft pink part in your mouth that holds your teeth in place!
quests.funFact: Baby teeth grow up through the gums when you are very young.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that you can feel move under your skin when you shrug, not your neck!
quests.question: Shoulder Blade
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You can feel it move when you shrug.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Shoulder Blade is the flat bone on your upper back that helps your arm swing!
quests.funFact: Shoulder blades help your arms swing freely up, down, and around.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that covers your whole body, from head to toe. It is also the one you protect from sunburn with sunscreen, but it is NOT your bones!
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: Hint: It helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Skin protects everything inside your body, like a snug, stretchy coat.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that faces up when someone gives you a high five. It is also the one that feels flat and soft, right in the middle of your hand, but it is NOT your armpits!
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: Hint: A high five lands right on these.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: Your palms help you get a good, safe grip on things.
